reason_text_en: Offers like 'Earn ₹50,000 daily' are usually fake. Real jobs and investments don't pay like this.
No real investment can guarantee profit or be free of risk. This is a common trick.

description: Requests for OTP, PIN, CVV, passwords or ID numbers
reason_title_en: Asks for personal or payment information
reason_text_en: Banks and government offices never ask for your OTP, PIN, CVV or password by message or call.
Scammers rush you so you don't stop to think or check with someone.

description: Suspicious link: URL shortener, IP address, punycode or non-HTTPS
reason_text_en: The link hides where it really goes or is not secure. Don't open it.

description: Look-alike brand host. Each pattern is brand_token:official_domain; a host containing the token that is not the official domain (or its subdomain) matches.
reason_title_en: Link pretends to be a trusted brand
reason_text_en: The website name looks like a bank or government site but it is not the official one.

description: Asks to install an app or APK
reason_title_en: Asks you to install an unknown app
reason_text_en: Apps sent through messages can read your OTPs and steal money. Install apps only from the Play Store or App Store.

description: Advance fee before loan or prize
reason_title_en: Asks for money before giving a loan or prize
reason_text_en: Genuine lenders and prizes don't ask you to pay a fee first.

description: Threat to block account / KYC expiry
reason_text_en: Banks don't block accounts through random messages. Check directly with your bank branch or official app.

reason_title_en: Says you won a prize you never entered for
reason_text_en: You can't win a lottery or draw you never joined.

description: Impersonates a government office or bank. Counts only together with R02 or R03.
reason_title_en: Pretends to be a government office or bank
reason_text_en: Government offices never threaten arrest or ask for money on calls or chats. 'Digital arrest' is not real.
Paying you for likes or small tasks is a trap. Later they ask you to 'invest' to unlock bigger payouts.

reason_title_en: Asks for remote access to your phone
reason_text_en: Screen-sharing apps let strangers see and control your phone, including your bank app.
Tip groups promising sure profits are usually not SEBI-registered and often vanish with your money.

reason_title_en: Trick to make you send money by UPI
reason_text_en: You never need to scan a QR code or enter your UPI PIN to receive money.

description: Pushes contact with an unknown mobile number. Counts only together with R01, R01b, R06 or R10.
reason_title_en: Pushes you to contact an unknown number
reason_text_en: Moving the chat to a personal number is how scammers avoid official checks.

description: All links are official domains and none of R02/R05/R06/R11 matched. Patterns are the official domains; requires_codes entries prefixed with ! must NOT have matched.
